{"tool": "write_file", "args": {"content": """"Re-send failed SMS messages.

Sends SMS: for every message in the SMS outbox whose gateway status is 'failed',
queue one new message to the same household with the same template, params and
text as the original. Households whose message was delivered are not texted.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from config import settings
from core import store
from core.ids import format_sms_id, next_number
from core.models import SmsMessage
from notifications.sms import delivery_status, sent_messages


def main() -> None:
    messages = sent_messages()
    status = delivery_status()
    for m in messages:
        if status.get(m.id) != "failed":
            continue
        new_id = format_sms_id(next_number([x.id for x in sent_messages()], "SMS-"))
        resend = SmsMessage(
            id=new_id,
            household_id=m.household_id,
            phone=m.phone,
            template_id=m.template_id,
            params=dict(m.params),
            text=m.text,
            queued_at=settings.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        )
        store.append_jsonl("outbox/sms.jsonl", resend.to_dict())
        store.append_jsonl("data/audit.jsonl", {
            "event": "sms_resend",
            "actor": "scripts/resend_failed_sms.py",
            "ref": new_id,
            "at": settings.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        })
        print(f"re-queued {new_id} for {m.household_id} (original {m.id})")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
